turns.text: Among the emails to Sam, find only the open ones and close each of them.
turns.rephrase: I mean: find the open emails to Sam and close them all.

turns.text: Get every open email going to Xena and close each of them.
turns.rephrase: I mean: find the open emails to Xena and close them all.

turns.text: :propose close_open_emails_to <<PROCEDURE close_open_emails_to(person:PERSON, status:STATUS) ; $v0 = FIND EMAIL WHERE SELF.RECIPIENT={person} STATUS={status} ; FOR $v1 IN $v0 : SET_STATUS $v1 CLOSED ; RETURN $v0 ; END>>
